prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct the geometry of image 2, the Qing Jiangnan two-storey restaurant sprite, using image 1 as exact mandatory ground plane. Keep the restaurant architecture, gray tile roof, cream plaster, dark timber balcony, dining tables, tiny plants and realistic detailed muted ancient game style. Change only its camera/projection and fit to the ground plane. Exact 2:1 orthographic dimetric (azimuth45 elevation30), no perspective. On 1536x1024 canvas use guide ground outer corners LEFT=(168,587), FRONT=(854,930), RIGHT=(1368,673), BACK=(682,330). Width/depth=12:9. Ground edge slopes exactly +0.500 and -0.500; current style-reference sprite is too steep at .535, so lower the view angle a little and preserve the guide. Lock these outer three visible corners, do not reinterpret them or draw an enlarged base. Every ground-floor sill, balcony level, stone rim must align parallel to this exact plane. Retexture guide into a thin believable worn gray stone pavement under the restaurant with narrow margins. No thick pedestal, no grid or diagram lines. Keep entire roof within canvas. Actual transparent RGBA outside asset; upper-left light, tiny lower-right contact shadow only. No writing, signs, logos, people or modern things. Critical: visible left/front/right stone floor corners must stay at exact guide locations, and the shape must be a 12 by 9 rectangle under the prescribed projection.
